title: Continue #654 quality session isolation after lockfile recovery
rawUserRequest: Complete GitHub Issue #654 on the latest main branch. The previous archived delivery PR #723 could not be merged after main advanced and is superseded. Return to the main plan; do not continue runner work. RayIori authorized automatic execution and external Issue/PR handling, including governed supersession/quarantine.

acceptance: A second make quality invocation in the same worktree deterministically fails fast with a clear Retry: make quality recovery command and produces no quality evidence.
Independent worktrees retain independent lock identities and can execute quality sessions in parallel.
Every public quality profile and direct project-test path acquires the worktree-local lock without recursive self-deadlock.
Regression tests exercise actual concurrent lock ownership, the busy path, child ownership propagation, and independent worktree locks.
Documentation accurately states the lock boundary, no-manual-deletion rule, recovery command, and cross-worktree parallelism.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A second same-worktree quality session is rejected without producing evidence
scenarioCoverage.expected: The first owner retains the kernel lock; the second caller exits 75 and prints Retry: make quality.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Hold the actual lock in a subprocess regression and assert the second invocation's exit code and stderr.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Independent worktrees hold independent quality locks
scenarioCoverage.expected: Lock identity is rooted under each worktree, so one worktree does not serialize another.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Acquire both distinct lock paths concurrently in a focused regression.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Nested quality targets join the existing owner rather than self-deadlock
scenarioCoverage.expected: The lock wrapper marks its child environment and the owned target runs once.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run a temporary Make target under the wrapper and assert the inherited owner marker.

guidelines: Fail closed with a canonical recovery command; never weaken or silently bypass coverage, quality, governance, security, installer, CI, Outcome, merge, convergence, or release gates.

Keep source-bound successor scope narrow: no runner or CodeQL configuration and no revival of archived #723.
User authorization: RayIori authorized automatic execution, external Issue/PR handling, supersession/quarantine, and recording this authority in each Contract.

intent.problem: Two overlapping make quality invocations in one worktree can concurrently write target/coverage.json, current-session state, and report paths. The old #654 delivery was archived but its PR conflicted after main advanced, so the same correction must be delivered by a fresh source-bound successor.
constraints: Remain bound to GitHub Issue #654 and current origin/main; do not revive, rebase, or mutate archived predecessor evidence.
Use a non-blocking worktree-local lock and preserve parallelism in distinct worktrees.
Do not change GitHub Actions runners, CodeQL, provider settings, lockfiles, or release policy in this Work Item.
Do not weaken any quality or governance gate.
intent.rationale: Kernel-managed locking prevents corrupted evidence at its source while a clean successor preserves the immutable audit trail of the unmerged predecessor.
